🇺🇦🇪🇺 Zelensky says the $27 billion hole is plugged, by spending next year's money now

Zelensky told Reuters that Ukraine has found the funding to cover this year's budget gap and to place drone orders for the start of 2027. He called it a success for Ukraine and the European Union, after his team returned from talks in Brussels.

The gap in question is a $27 billion shortfall in Kiev's defence budget. According to Zelensky, it will be covered by three things: reallocating Ukraine's own budget funds, bilateral aid from individual countries, and drawing early on next year's share of the EU's €90 billion loan.

Zelensky gave no figures for how much comes from each source, or which spending inside Ukraine gets cut to free up funds.
